metadata.case_name: LAU WING KONG v. HUNG WING STEEL ENGINEERING LIMITED AND OTHERS

injuries.description: His left hand was completely amputated from above the elbow by a fallen steel rack (“the Rack”) which he was trying to erect with other co-workers inside a steel core store on an industrial site at Tsz Wan Shan, Kowloon (“the Site”).
source: His left hand was completely amputated from above the elbow by a fallen steel rack (“the Rack”) which he was trying to erect with other co-workers inside a steel core store on an industrial site at Tsz Wan Shan, Kowloon (“the Site”).
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between left shoulder and elbow

manifestations.description: 62% impairment of the upper extremity, equivalent to 37% impairment of the whole person.
Various deformities at elbow and claw hand deformity. A nighttime resting splint and a daytime dynamic splint is necessary to prevent further deformity of the left hand.
Wasted lower arm (biceps muscle belly) and forearm muscle wasting.
Severely restricted movement of shoulder, wrist and fingers.
Inability to make a full fist and reduced handgrip power at grade 4-.
Circumferential scar of 22 cm long and longitudinal scar of 14 cm long.
Pain at elbow, worsen with the onset of climate.

Difficulty in handling his daily activities, which requires the use of both hands because of his stiff left elbow and weak left hand, and he has to resort to using his teeth. For instance, he is unable to wring or twist a towel and hold a rice bowl, it is difficult for him to clean his right side and to put on clothing, and he is unable to perform any household chores.
Depressed personality and outlook on life.

treatments_received: He was assessed by Dr. Chung Siu Yeung and Dr. Jack Wong, specialists in Orthopaedics & Traumatology, on 28 February 2006.
he was given sick leave for a total of 898 days from 12 August 2003 to 15 August 2005, from 26September 2006 to 21 December 2006 and from 6 March 2008 to 22 May 2008.
treatments_future: Fitting of prosthesis: recommended "N-Abler III WHO Soft Brace" with accessories and professional fitting and maintenance (one set every 5 years).

losses.description: Complete amputation of the left hand above the elbow with resulting deformity, muscle wasting, reduced handgrip and reduced sensation.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: He is unable to perform any household chores and has great difficulty with tasks such as wringing or twisting a towel, holding a rice bowl, cleaning and putting on clothing.
He is independent in personal hygiene, putting on clothing, reading and feeding only with great difficulty due to stiff left elbow and weak left hand.
Depressed personality and outlook on life.
He was unable to return to his pre-injury job as a welder/iron worker and is severely handicapped in the labour market.
